transaction_velocity.reason: Directly represents burst intensity. Hourly tx count deviation from baseline is the primary burst indicator.

total_amount.reason: Fraud amounts differ by 7.85x from legitimate. Adds value context to velocity.

avg_amount.reason: Derived from total_amount and tx_count. Useful for detecting unusual per-transaction values but redundant with total_amount as a standalone signal.

amount_std.reason: High uniformity of amounts within a burst (low std) may indicate automated activity. Useful but secondary.

hour_of_day.reason: Peak/trough ratio is 1.6x. Modest hourly variation; use as context only.

day_of_week.reason: Day-of-week CV is 0.273. Some weekday/weekend difference; include as baseline context.

unique_cardholders.reason: Fraud windows: 0.998 unique cards/tx vs clean: 1.0. Similar cardholder density.

category_diversity.reason: Category distribution shift between fraud/legit: 0.388. Some category shift; may add value.

temporal_concentration.reason: Within a burst window, compressed inter-arrival times may indicate automated activity. Worth tracking as secondary signal.
